fields.value: Stereoscopic 3D-360 videos of typical media production use cases

dsDescriptionValue.value: Several datasets providing 4 or 8 different fisheye views generated from a Nokia OZO together with the recorded sound and an example of a stiched panorama. For each dataset, the data has been devided into three parts, each stored in a separate folder. • FisheyeData This folder has two subfolders. First subfolder contains metadata about the camera, including calibration parameters. Second subfolder is divided in either 4 or 8 subfolders depending on the recording settings i.e., number of cameras used to record the scene. They contain all fisheye frames in “OpenEXR” format (“EXR” files). • Audio This folder contains the audio stream from the scene: - 8-channels “WAV” file - First-order Ambisonic “WAV” file • Stitched This folder has an example of a stitched stereo panorama with Ambisonic audio. The stitching was performed by OZO Creator. The content was compressed with the video codec H.264 (“MP4” file).
